claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information, including track and Reference Point data, from the Surveillance NPG to support its platform mission.

goal.raw_text: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information, including track and Reference Point data, from the Surveillance NPG to support its platform mission.

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
The Link 16 network must be operational with a defined Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG).
The Non-C2 JU must be configured to monitor the Surveillance NPG but is prohibited from transmitting on this NPG.
Surveillance information, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission, must be available for transmission by C2 JUs within the Surveillance NPG.
Surveillance information, including track and Reference Point data, becomes available on the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG) for the Non-C2 JU to receive.

trigger.raw_text: Surveillance information, including track and Reference Point data, becomes available on the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG) for the Non-C2 JU to receive.

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG to receive situational awareness information.
The Non-C2 JU receives remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages.
The received data includes Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data reported via J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 messages respectively.
The Non-C2 JU uses the received track and Reference Point data to support its platform mission.
If a J7.0 message with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) is received, the Non-C2 JU shall process it for locally held remote tracks.
The Non-C2 JU may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified system-selected time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated.
If the received surveillance information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, the information may be purged in accordance with system design.
The Non-C2 JU has successfully received situational awareness information, including track and Reference Point data, from the Surveillance NPG.
The received data supports the Non-C2 JU's platform mission by providing situational awareness and early warning information.
